summary: What tech earnings reveal about AI investment and Donald Trump's tariff talks
content:
World Service , · 24 Jul 2026 , · 22 mins

Will Bain is joined by Nga Pham in Hanoi and Takara Small in Toronto. Following the latest results from Alphabet and Tesla, both companies are under pressure to sustain spending as competition in artificial intelligence intensifies. Is Wall Street beginning to question the cost of the AI race? Plus, the mounting economic impact of Canada's wildfires, why ketchup-flavoured crisps have become such a uniquely Canadian phenomenon, and what Donald Trump's renewed tariff negotiations could mean for global trade. (Photo: The Google logo, made up of different coloured letters - blue, red, yellow, blue, green, orange - on the Google house at the CES consumer electronics trade show, in Las Vegas, Nevada, US, 10 January, 2024. Credit: Steve Marcus/Reuters) You can email the team: businessdaily@bbc.co.uk Presenter: Will Bain Producer: David Cann
chineseSummary: 科技财报揭示了人工智能投资和唐纳德·特朗普关税谈判的哪些内容
chineseContent:
全球服务 , · 2026 年 7 月 24 日 , · 22 分钟

Will Bain 与河内的 Nga Pham 和多伦多的 Takara Small 一起参加。根据 Alphabet 和特斯拉的最新业绩，随着人工智能竞争的加剧，两家公司都面临着维持支出的压力。华尔街是否开始质疑人工智能竞赛的成本？此外，加拿大野火日益严重的经济影响、番茄酱味薯片为何成为加拿大独特的现象，以及唐纳德·特朗普重新启动关税谈判对全球贸易可能意味着什么。 （照片：2024 年 1 月 10 日在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯举行的 CES 消费电子贸易展上，Google 标志由不同颜色的字母组成 - 蓝色、红色、黄色、蓝色、绿色、橙色。图片来源：Steve Marcus/Reuters）您可以向团队发送电子邮件：businessdaily@bbc.co.uk 演示者：Will Bain 制片人：David Cann
